build_data2vec_text_classification_model: build a Data2VecTextClassificationModel from a pretrained checkpoint config using build_model
register_classification_head: register a RobertaClassificationHead with num_classes and inner_dim on the model
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the model with source tokens and a classification head name
load_model_weights: load pretrained model weights from a checkpoint state dict excluding decoder keys
configure_data2vec_text_classification: configure Data2VecTextClassificationConfig with pooler dropout, activation function, and model path
